summary: Build practical citizen engagement, deliberation, and open government skills with hands-on planning tools. Enroll your team today.
lede: Public participation in open government links citizen input with transparent decisions and follow-up. For professionals working in consultation, policy, accountability or civic participation, the course develops practical skills in scoping engagement, selecting deliberative and co-design methods, and planning inclusive recruitment. Participants also learn to capture evidence, trace how input informs decisions, and report outcomes in clear public-facing summaries.
audienceIntro: This advanced citizen engagement and open government training is designed for professionals who already work with public consultation, policy development, accountability, or civic participation and now need a more rigorous method for planning and documenting engagement.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Prior experience in public sector policy, governance, community engagement, communications, or accountability roles is recommended. You should have working familiarity with policy cycles, consultation processes, and basic stakeholder analysis. No coding is required, but you should be prepared to work with planning templates, engagement matrices, and structured case exercises. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, with hands-on practice focused on planning, design, and reporting artefacts rather than large-scale programme implementation.
